description: Power BI report with interactive visualizations (charts, tables, maps) bound to a semantic model. Created programmatically or in the portal. PBIR format (one file per visual) is the modern standard; PBIR-Legacy (single report.json) supports programmatic visual creation with data rendering.

definition_parts.description: REQUIRED. Semantic model binding (pbiModelDatabaseName = semantic model UUID). MS schema requires $schema; fabio's --dataset binding sends the report/definitionProperties/1.0.0 schema URL (6-field byConnection); Fabric normalizes to 2.0.0 on ingest.
PBIR-Legacy: all pages and visuals in one file
PBIR: version metadata (version must be semver like '4.0.0')

flags.--dataset: Semantic model ID to bind (auto-generates definition.pbir + blank report.json). With --definition, rebinds the folder's definition.pbir to this model by connection.
flags.--file: Path to a single definition.pbir file
flags.--definition: Path to a FULL PBIR report folder (a .Report folder or any folder containing definition.pbir). All files are gathered recursively (definition.pbir + report.json OR definition/** pages/visuals) and sent as the report definition. This is the agent-native path: generate PBIR files, validate, then create.

notes: --dataset is the simplest path: auto-generates both definition files (a blank one-page PBIR-Legacy report)
--definition <folder> creates a full multi-page PBIR (enhanced) report from generated files — the way a coding agent should ship a real report

ALWAYS run 'fabio report validate --source <folder>' before create --definition / deploy: it checks required PBIR files, $schema presence, JSON validity, byPath vs byConnection, and version/format compatibility offline (no tenant call)

byPath (relative path to a .SemanticModel) is fine for deploy (fabio rewrites it to byConnection) but 'report create' needs byConnection — pass --dataset with --definition to rebind a byPath folder to a concrete model id
definition.pbir is ALWAYS required for update-definition (even if only updating visuals)
PBIR-Legacy with prototypeQuery is REQUIRED for visuals that render data programmatically; PBIR (enhanced) is the documented, agent-editable format and becomes the only format at GA
